description:
A Sustainability Specialist is finalizing a Q3 2024 Sustainability Report presentation for a board meeting. The presentation is already open in LibreOffice Impress at ~/Documents/Presentations/sustainability_report.odp. It contains 5 slides with text, but three specific data charts are missing.

Your task is to insert the correct chart images from the ~/Documents/Presentations/images/ folder onto their corresponding slides:

1. Insert 'energy_chart.png' onto Slide 2 (titled 'Energy Consumption Overview')
2. Insert 'waste_breakdown.png' onto Slide 3 (titled 'Waste Reduction Progress')
3. Insert 'water_usage.png' onto Slide 4 (titled 'Water Conservation Results')

Do NOT add images to Slide 1 or Slide 5. Position the images appropriately so they don't cover the text. Save the presentation (Ctrl+S) when finished.
